replies.author: meiklety
replies.body:
Seriously everyone is trying to make a tool they can monetize. But it is obvious it is solvable on your own…and thus we are not too far out from actual free options. 

We are just in the weird period right now when the path for most vibe coders is too hard and the free options aren’t available, so the first people to figure it out are trying to make a buck (can’t blame them, but this isn’t going to be this way for long).
